fusions.name: Raiding Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 5 darting bolts at once, spread wide, each dealing 5 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back as healing over 6 seconds, and your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Picked to the Bone
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: deals 20 damage plus 1.8 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up.

fusions.name: Plunder Swarm
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that harries enemies within 5 tiles for 12 seconds, dealing 4 damage every second. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after calling it.

fusions.name: Gorged and Ready
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
